mainEntity.name: Can a fixed skylight be installed on any roof type?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixed skylights can be installed on most common roof types, including asphalt shingles, wood shakes, and tile roofs. However, the specific installation method and flashing components will vary depending on the roofing material and pitch. Flat roofs may require a curb-mounted skylight, while sloped roofs use deck-mounted options. A professional evaluation by Hometelligent Inc. can determine the feasibility and best approach for your specific roof in areas like Emeryville or San Leandro, ensuring proper sealing and structural integrity.
